RWS_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.description: Same idempotency key was replayed with a different payload hash.

RWS_HEAD_MISMATCH.description: Git HEAD or file ETag differs from the caller's expected value.

RWS_PATH_INVALID.description: Path is outside the working copy or is not portable.

RWS_MOUNT_INVALID.description: Mount reference is not registered or cannot be resolved safely.

RWS_LEASE_CONFLICT.description: Another active writer holds the working-copy lease.

RWS_CAPABILITY_DENIED.description: Actor or agent capability does not permit the operation.

RWS_BINDING_INVALID.description: Workspace binding is expired, revoked, or does not match the run.

RWS_ASSET_INCOMPLETE.description: Referenced LFS object or immutable asset is not ready.

RWS_GIT_REJECTED.description: Git provider rejected a push, merge, or protected-ref operation.

RWS_INDEX_RECONCILE_REQUIRED.description: RAGPortal receipt is timeout, duplicate, stale, or out of order.
